newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS expects higher return on equity.
newsitem.headline: UBS expects higher return on equity.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said on Friday it expected its return on equity (ROE) to increase to around 12 percent in the near future.

"Provided market conditions remain reasonably favourable, we anticipate a rapid increase in our return on equity to around 12 percent," UBS chief executive Mathis Cabiallavetta said in a speech to be presented with earnings results.
He said this was in line with a UBS strategic objective of achieving an ROE of six to eight percent above the risk-free interest rate.
He said, however, UBS did not intend to pursue this goal at the risk of compromising its risk profile in any way.
